en: Dependent on a state that is with-conflict (*saraṇa*) and to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is without-conflict (*na-saraṇa*) and not to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: one; under predominance-condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is without-conflict (*araṇa*) and not to be abandoned by vision, there arises a state that is without-conflict and not to be abandoned by vision, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: one. (Abbreviated.)

Conditioned by a state that is without conflict (*araṇa*) and surpassable (*sauttara*), a state that is without refuge (*nasaraṇa*) and unsurpassable (*na-sauttara*) arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. [There is] one [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict and unsurpassable (*anuttara*), a state that is without refuge and not unsurpassable arises by way of the root condition. [There is] one under root, one under predominance; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
(The section on co-nascence and the section on inquiry should also be expanded in detail.)
The Exposition of the Pairs of Twos on the Positive-Negative Order of Phenomena is completed.
The Exposition of the Positive-Negative Order is completed.
